articles.summary: RingCentral selected for AI-first business communications and open platform approach BELMONT, Calif. & NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- RingCentral, Inc. (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, today announced a new partnership with the New York Mets to modernize fan engagement, ticket sales, and business communications across the organization. The Mets are replacing a legacy, on-premise phone system with RingCentral's cloud platform, elevating how employees connect with fans and with each other. Citing RingCentral's track record with other Major League Baseball organizations, the Mets selected RingCentral for its native Microsoft integrations and commitment to a long-term partnership around their business needs. “Our goal is to be the most fan-friendly and technology-driven organization in baseball, and that means continually investing in tools that strengthen how we connect with our fans and one another,” said Oscar Fernandez, Senior Vice President of Technology, New York Mets. “RingCentral provides a flexible, scalable communications platform that will help our sales team engage more fans while supporting greater collaboration across the organization. Its open-platform approach and compatibility with our existing technology environment will help streamline workflows, improve visibility and allow us to operate more efficiently.” With RingCentral, the Mets will: Connect all 800 employees on one platform. RingEX ™ replaces the legacy on-premise system for day-to-day communications. Drive fan engagement. RingCX ™ enables the sales team to call and text every fan lead, with unlimited toll-free and outbound calling. Provide dedicated support as they scale. Advanced Support puts a RingCentral team behind both solutions. "The Mets came to us with a clear goal: to expand their ability to connect with fans while creating a modern, scalable communications foundation across the organization,” said Joe Jacob, SVP, Global Enterprise Sales, RingCentral. "RingCX will help their sales team act on more opportunities and engage fans at scale, while RingEX gives the whole organization a modern foundation to work from. The result is a better experience on both sides – fans receive faster, more personalized engagement, and the Mets have more tools for their sales operation to run more efficiently." About the New York Mets Established in 1962, the New York Mets are a Major League Baseball team competing in the National League East. Based at Citi Field in Flushing, Queens, the Mets are owned by Steve Cohen. articles.summary: Makes conversation data accessible and actionable in LLMs with the governance and secure access that businesses expect Helps business users save time, improve productivity, and complete tasks BELMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- RingCentral, Inc. (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, today announced a new plugin for ChatGPT and MCP (model context protocol) connectors for Claude to make voice, SMS, and chat data available in LLMs. This enables business users to prompt actions that save time, improve productivity, and complete tasks to drive better business outcomes. “Businesses around the world rely on RingCentral for calls that close deals, texts that confirm orders, chats that keep teams aligned. Every one of those conversations carry important signals, like who the customer is, what they need, what happened previously,” said Kira Makagon, President & COO, RingCentral. “MCP makes that interaction context available directly in the LLMs that businesses already use, so they can securely utilize their own data to drive outcomes.” Conversations contain vital interaction context reflecting customer intent, needs, follow-up next steps, pain points, and buying behaviors. LLMs provide a reasoning layer that can act on information. RingCentral fuels that information with rich conversation data. Businesses can leverage RingCentral’s MCP connectors for workflows such as: Prioritize the opportunity pipeline: Combine call history and CRM data to prioritize leads and generate relevant talking points based on customer needs for an immediate outbound message. Recover the sale while the cart is still warm: Send personalized SMS reminders as a follow-up next step based on abandoned shopping carts in Shopify and other web stores to nudge buyers to purchase. Catch escalations before they get escalated: Automate the review of conversation transcripts to flag urgent issues and update support tickets. Start your day with a to-do list based on conversations: Leverage messages, calls, voicemails, and data combined with third-party project management systems to create prioritized task lists with actionable next items. “The next stage of customer interaction will depend on how effectively businesses connect AI with the conversation data and interaction context where customer needs, intent and history are captured. Until now, most of that context has stayed locked away from the tools where decisions actually get made," said Michelle Morgan, Research Director, AI-Enabled Sales, Customer Service, and Contact Center at IDC. “Open protocols like MCP let that context travel to wherever the work happens, instead of requiring a new integration for every AI platform. RingCentral opening its communications data this way is a signal of where the market is headed: agents and employees pulling from the same connected context, instead of each working from a different, incomplete picture.” How a local OrangeTheory Fitness went from conversations to outcomes At OrangeTheory Fitness in Warner Robins, Georgia, Franchise Owner Cam Lothridge used to sift through hundreds of texts and emails to form a view on qualified leads and opportunities. With the RingCentral ChatGPT plugin, he began to unlock data and conversations to gain insights and take action. "The RingCentral ChatGPT plugin increased our lead response rate by 50 percent. It analyzes message performance to show us what drives better conversions, revenue, and member retention. It also transforms how our team catches up between shifts. Instead of staff spending 45 minutes scrolling through hundreds of conversations and texts, the plugin automatically summarizes customer interactions into immediate next steps, getting staff up to speed in under five minutes. With the plugin, I'm able to step back, check the pulse of the business, and take action," said Lothridge. Governance and trust, built in With governance and access controls built-in, business admins can stay in control when leveraging RingCentral’s MCP connectors with the LLMs they prefer. RingCentral delivers access management by role and individual. It maintains identity-aware access based on a user’s existing permissions. This includes what data the LLM has access to and when, for example, being able to limit the LLM to call data only on specific prompts. RingCentral-built MCPs extend the same level of trust and security that RingCentral’s core services have delivered to businesses for decades across regulated vertical industries. Availability New MCP connectors include voice, SMS, and chat and are available now with all paid RingEX plans. This represents the first step in RingCentral’s broader agent platform roadmap. The plugin for ChatGPT is available and can be installed from RingCentral’s App Gallery and the ChatGPT Directory . For more information and details visit RingCentral . articles.summary: Recognized for technology innovation, reputation, impact, and R&D investment BELMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- RingCentral, Inc. (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, today announced it has been named to Business Insider America's Most Innovative Businesses 2027 list , produced in partnership with Plant-A Insights Group. The list recognizes publicly traded U.S. companies that distinguish themselves through strong innovation performance, combining industry reputation, technological impact, and investment in research and development. This marks the first year Business Insider and Plant-A Insights Group have partnered to produce the ranking. The study reviewed more than 4,000 publicly traded U.S. companies using patent data and financial metrics, 1,600 of which advanced to further evaluation. The 500 highest scoring companies were recognized to the list. “This recognition reflects the work our teams put into reimagining how businesses communicate and engage their customers with AI at the core,” said Kira Makagon, President & COO, RingCentral. “We’re at an incredibly exciting inflection point as Agentic Voice AI transforms what’s possible in customer engagement — moving beyond automation to create more intelligent, personalized and impactful experiences. We’re honored to be included and energized by what it represents. We will continue to push boundaries, drive innovation, and deliver meaningful outcomes for our customers.” The evaluation by Business Insider measured the following: Reputation — peer-to-peer industry ratings gathered through a nationwide survey of more than 67,000 U.S. working professionals, who rated companies in their own industry on an 11-point innovation scale. Impact — analysis of patent data, including forward citations, non-patent citations, industry reach, absolute patent volume, and patent intensity growth. Investment — R&D investment, R&D intensity growth, and deviation from industry-median R&D spending. As businesses increasingly turn to AI to improve customer experiences and empower employees, RingCentral is seeing strong momentum across its Agentic Voice AI portfolio . The Company’s continued recognition by leading industry and business organizations, including Business Insider, TIME , and Gartner , reinforces RingCentral’s leadership in AI innovation and the opportunity ahead.
